subject: Discovery recap + POC action tracker for Helios - proposed cadence
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@helios-ai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T15:20:00Z
Subject: Discovery recap + POC action tracker for Helios - proposed cadence

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap of what we heard and a proposed POC approach so we can lock timelines and owners. I pasted an action tracker below (short) — please confirm or update.

Key constraints from your side
- Need private VPC deployment with strict egress controls (security will validate).
- Success metric focus: response quality for intent extraction + production latency targets.
- Procurement timeline likely 2-3 weeks after MOP acceptance.

Proposed POC overview (4-week technical validation)
- Goal: validate Helios search assistant in production-like conditions for 100k queries (synthetic + sample prod traces).
- Success criteria (suggested):
  * Functional: intent extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the supplied test set in week 3; rerank precision@5 improved vs baseline by >= 10%.
  * Performance: median tail latency < 200ms (p50) and p95 < 400ms for 512-token prompts under continuous load of 20 TPS.
  * Cost: target serving cost < $X per 1M tokens (we'll model with your traffic profile).
  * Security/compliance: keys in your KMS, logs forwarded to your SIEM, SOC2 evidence shared.

Mutual action tracker (owners + ETA)
1) Share representative test dataset and a simple set of 50 target queries (Helios) — Owner: Sophie / Helios SME — ETA: 2027-07-22
2) Redwood to spin up POC env (VPC + infra) and provide access + onboarding doc — Owner: marissa_cole — ETA: 2027-07-23
3) Security questionnaire & SOC2 artifacts (redwood) + Helios security contacts — Owner: lauren_bishop; request proton contact for SOC2 exchange — ETA: 2027-07-24
4) Procurement MOP review & signoff; share PO cadence — Owner: procurement@helios-ai.com — ETA: 2027-08-05
5) Run baseline vs Redwood serving and deliver week-by-week metric snapshot — Owner: ben_carter — Weekly updates starting 2027-07-26

Attachments: helios_mvp_requirements.pdf (sample acceptance criteria), redwood_poc_mop.xlsx (draft MOP).

Proposed cadence: weekly 30-min sync (engineering + product) — Mondays 10am PT, kickoff Monday 2027-07-26. If that works for you I'll send a calendar invite and the access steps.

Thanks — want to keep this lightweight and actionable.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: helios_mvp_requirements.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)]

From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@helios-ai.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helios-ai.com
Date: 2027-07-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + POC action tracker for Helios - proposed cadence

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications and additions: 

1) Procurement: I'll loop in our procurement team (copied). They typically need an MOP + quote before PO; target timeline is as noted but could slip if we need a security review first.
2) Security: our security lead asked for: SOC2 type II report, network diagram for your VPC deployment, and confirmation that log forwarding can go to our Splunk endpoint.
3) Dataset: we'll share a subset of anonymized traces + 50 query samples by Fri (2027-07-22). We will redline the MOP with a couple of comments (data retention and masking).

Small ask: can Redwood provide an estimated token cost model against our historical week (I can share a small sample log to estimate)? Also — can you confirm whether the VPC deployment will be in us-west-2? Our infra team prefers that region.

We'd like to dial in the success criteria: the product team will review the F1 threshold but the latency goals look reasonable.

Proposed kickoff: yes to Mon 2027-07-26 10am PT.

Sophie
Sophie Tran
Head of Product, Helios AI
[Attachment: helios_acceptance_criteria.docx (DOCX, 34 KB)]

Attached: redwood_poc_mop.xlsx (draft with suggested SLAs & retention notes). I'll also create the calendar invite for the 26th with the agenda: 1) access & env, 2) baseline run, 3) roles + next steps.
